name: inspect_packet_fields
description: Discover protocols or field names/types registered in the installed TShark 4.x. kind defaults to protocols; use fields and optional exact protocol abbreviation to select field definitions. query searches name/abbreviation/description by case-insensitive literal substring. Return 50 matches by default with offset/limit paging; null requests all remaining within resource limits. Preserve type/base/bitmask/description, duplicate registrations, source line numbers, coverage, tool identity and diagnostics. Linux, REA_TSHARK_COMMAND and prlimit required. No capture file, interface or binary target needed. Registrations describe tool capabilities, not observed traffic. Each call rereads the glossary; use selected fields with inspect_packet_capture.

kind.description: Return protocol registrations or field definitions; defaults to protocols

limit.description: Maximum matches returned; null requests all remaining within the record budget

offset.description: Number of matching records to skip; defaults to 0

protocol.description: Exact protocol abbreviation; selects that protocol or its registered fields

query.description: Case-insensitive literal substring in name, abbreviation or field description
